Keep just imperceptible uniform material variation, with all floor details subdued. Outer corner grass tufts and cones unchanged. Keep the white field markings faint and outside the middle zone. No new objects, no text, UI, snake, balls or central line/circle. This is final production art, not a labeled comparison.
